simple.summary: יָעַז (yâʻaz) means to be bold or obstinate First listed occurrence: Isa 33 19.

definitions.full: H3267. yaaz [ יָעַז ] verb only Niph`al Participle as adjective (precise meaning dubious; Arabic is give a nod or sign , then command , whence Hebrew might have meaning nodding, making signs (not intelligibly speaking), so Hi — Che barbarous , De 'ungeberdig' — which context favours, or arrogant ; Thes proposes durus, saevus , and compare עזז ) — in phrase נוֺעָז עַם Isa 33:19 a barbarous (?) people , of foreign invader. יעזיהו יעזיאל, see below עזה . יַעְזִרִ see below עזר . p. 741.
